Market today: Mixed signals. Positive tech news (Zscaler) but macro uncertainty with the upcoming jobs report and ongoing calls for Fed rate cuts. This environment can create volatility, especially for your concentrated, margin-fueled tech/chip book.

Your holdings: SOXL is a major concern, down -58.06% and leveraged. SPAL, also leveraged, is down -31.73% and new. SMH (-13.17%) and QQQI (-3.12%) are both on TRIM status and nearing their stops. Margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the August jobs report Friday for its impact on Fed rate expectations. Also, monitor any further signs of retail speculative activity in tech names.

Bottom line: Focus on managing risk in your leveraged and underperforming positions before considering new opportunities.
plays: SOXL: Review this leveraged position immediately. At -58.06% and "SELL" status, consider trimming significantly or cutting losses to protect capital, especially given your margin use.
SMH: Respect your stop at 540. If it breaks, trim as indicated by your scanner status.
QQQI: Respect your stop at 52. If it breaks, trim as indicated by your scanner status.
